blockingFindings.title: Test file references fs without importing it
blockingFindings.issue: makeAgent calls fs.mkdtempSync, but the test file imports os and path only. This makes every test path that calls makeAgent fail with ReferenceError before exercising production behavior.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a Node fs import, for example `import fs from "node:fs";`.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A test that is not executable is a concrete implementation blocker because it cannot provide valid regression coverage.

blockingFindings.title: R6 file generation behavior is not covered
blockingFindings.issue: The R6 test verifies prompt target options and target resolution, but it does not verify that non-interactive dual-agent setup actually generates both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files by default.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local test that runs the relevant setup generation path or file-writing helper for dual-agent non-interactive setup and asserts both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are created or scheduled for creation by the production setup behavior.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R6 includes a concrete generation requirement, and the current coverage stops at target selection metadata rather than the production behavior that writes or emits the files.
